'''Bubse spice''' was a chemical extracted from the root of the [[Bubse tree/Legends|bubse tree]]. It functioned as an [[Anesthetic/Legends|anesthetic]] and was found in many [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Each dose cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], while a pack of 100 doses averaged 17,500 credits.<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen" />
